text: Accountability The Water Works. Jabo Waggoner co-sponsored the state takeover of the Birmingham Water Works. He's a named defendant in a $1.6 billion federal lawsuit over that takeover. His answer to WBRC was two words: "No comment." Every claim cited. Read the sources ›

Follow the money The Book. Jabo Waggoner's campaign paid $60,000 to the chairman of a charity created to publish a book about the senator — run out of his event-marketer's office, with a registered lobbyist on its board. Lobbyists bought the book at an RSA Plaza signing businesses paid for. Then the IRS revoked the charity for not filing its returns, and its state registration expired. Every claim cited to a public record. Read the sources ›

Money in politics The Meta Money. A California tech company wrote a $540,000 check to an Alabama super PAC. Four days later, $70,302.64 of it bought support for Jabo Waggoner's primary. Meta has $3 billion in Alabama data centers. Every line traceable to public filings. Read the sources ›
